meta.name: Lingala Word Bank
meta.description: Lingala vocabulary with English meanings, phonetic guides, part of speech, and example sentences. Verified entries are hand-checked; unverified entries are sourced vocabulary awaiting community review.
meta.phoneticSystem: Syllables separated by hyphens; the stressed syllable is shown in CAPITALS (e.g. mo-SA-la). A blank phonetic means it has not yet been verified.
meta.sourceNote: Word-to-meaning facts derived from a public English-Lingala / Lingala-English dictionary for reference; phonetics reformatted into this project's notation and all example sentences and cultural notes written independently. Unverified entries may contain OCR artifacts and should be checked before publishing.
